about: The collecta of the formulary “Saint Stephen, the First Martyr” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant us, we beseech thee, O Lord, so to imitate what we revere, that we may learn to love even our enemies; for we celebrate the heavenly birthday of him who knew how to pray for his very persecutors to our Lord Jesus Christ: Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
